Name: Dedicated Decorative Storage
Author: novust
Description:
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/4nSpk6hp/description.png[/img][/b]

This mod includes:

• [b]A hay bale - 70 inventory slots:[/b] 
Perfect for keeping hay inside your coop/barn for manual feeding, or next to your silo to have to top it up less often.

• [b]A woodpile (tied with rope or not tied) - 36 inventory slots:[/b] 
A nice way to hold all your wood and hardwood neatly next to the fireplace, your workbench, or a charcoal kiln.

• [b]A wood & stone cabinet (exactly like the one seen at the Carpenter's Shop) - 150 inventory slots:[/b] 
An aesthetically pleasing way to hold your wood, hardwood, and stone for storing or crafting.
Includes a half-sized version with 70 inventory slots, and mirrored (L/R) versions of both sizes.

These storage pieces will [u]ONLY[/u] accept the listed items and [u]nothing else[/u]! 


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/FqNzB6cX/requirements-installation.png[/img][/b]

• The latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51208]Flexible Storage Framework[/url].
• Download and unzip into your mods folder the regular way.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7FWbmvc/in-game-requirements.png[/img]

None! 

The crafting recipes are available at their respective shops - Marnie's Ranch (hay bale) or Robin's Shop (everything else) - from the beginning, and the items themselves can also be purchased for half the price of their own crafting recipe.

Note: Be careful not mix up the Hay Bale with the Ornamental Hay Bale, also sold by Marnie. They look identical!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img]

• Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30321]Carry Chests[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32562]Stack More Things[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30323]Unlimited Storage[/url] (these mods are also all compatible with each other!)
• No known incompatibilities. Please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53618?tab=posts]let me know[/url] if you find one.
• Not tested in multiplayer or on Android. Please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53618?tab=posts]let me know[/url] what works (or doesn't!) 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img]

More dedicated storage items, if I can think find any. I'm open to suggestions!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/tMnmNWTs/my-mods.png[/img]

• Please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/novust/mods]my mod page[/url] for anything I've made since this one!
